title: Incremental rollout controller for Optimize autosuggestions with canary gating and human-in-loop approvals
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background: Optimize now generates batching/caching configuration suggestions that can reduce per-token costs but changing runtime configs en masse risks regressions. Goal: implement a safe auto-apply flow that can progressively roll suggested configs via gated rollouts and canary policies, require approvals where appropriate, and provide automated rollback triggers.

Scope: controller service + state machine to orchestrate suggestion proposals, a canary executor that applies configs to a configurable subset of traffic, metric-based health checks (latency, error rate, model output quality proxy), approval workflows (auto-approve thresholds + manual signoff for high-risk), and audit/logging for every change. This ticket implements the controller, policy DSL, and integration points for the Optimize UI and Console audit logs.

Non-goals: UI polish for the Console (handled by PM/design tickets), deep model re-eval infra (we will surface results from existing eval runner).

Key behaviors: proposals start in dry-run (simulation) mode; on positive simulation score, controller can schedule a canary: apply to X% of traffic for Y minutes, compute canary score: token-cost delta, p95 latency delta, error-rate delta, and output-consistency proxy. If score passes configured thresholds, auto-progress to ramp-up steps. If score fails, auto-rollback and notify SRE/PM via configured channels. For proposals with expected cost-savings >= 30% or impacting more than 10 customers, require explicit product + SRE approval before any canary apply.
tasks: Define policy DSL for gated rollouts (percentages, durations, thresholds)
Implement proposal store and idempotent controller for lifecycle transitions
Build canary executor that applies runtime config to routing layer for given tenancy/segments
Integrate metric hooks: cost-savings, p95 latency, error-rate, synthetic quality probes
Implement automated rollback triggers and exponential backoff retry logic
Add audit events to Console event stream and add proposal links in Optimize UI
Create e2e integration tests and synthetic simulation suite
Documentation: runbook for emergency rollback and operator playbook
acceptance_criteria: Controller can create a proposal and run a dry-run simulation returning cost + quality deltas
Canary apply can be executed against 1%, 5%, 20% traffic segments and strictly scoped tenants
Health check engine evaluates canary within configured duration and enforces thresholds
Automatic rollback triggers when any primary health metric regresses beyond threshold
Audit log contains proposal id, proposer, applied config diff, canary windows, and outcome
Manual approval gate blocks canary start for high-risk proposals and records approver and rationale
comments: 2026-02-22 Asha: Kickoff with PM/Infra. Confirmed thresholds proposed by product: p95 <= baseline+10ms, error rate delta <= 0.1%, cost reduction target >=10%. Action: Miguel to draft policy DSL.
2026-02-28 Miguel: POC of canary executor completed against the staging routing layer. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3344
2026-03-03 SRE review (Liam Becker): flagged tenant isolation gap when applying routing-level changes; added dependency ENG-8120 for safe tenancy scopes
2026-03-05 Design feedback (Zoë Kim): Console needs explicit 'revert' CTA in audit view; tracked in PM backlog PM-421

2026-03-10 QA: Synthetic probe suite added, initial runs show 12% median cost reduction on test workloads and no measurable p95 regression in 95% of runs. Two failed runs tied to a batching edge-case; created follow-up ENG-8401

2026-03-12 Miguel: Implemented approval flow hooks. Manual approval required when proposal.meta.estimated_savings >= 30% OR proposal.targets.multitenant_count > 10. Hook is configurable via org-level policy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3379
notes: Rollout policy defaults: canary_steps = [1,5,20], canary_duration_minutes = 30, pass_score = composite_score >= 0.9
Composite score weights: cost_savings_weight=0.5, latency_weight=0.3, error_rate_weight=0.2
Operators can set tenant opt-out label 'optimize:auto-apply=disabled' to prevent automated changes
All changes must emit audit events with proposal id for compliance; retention configured by Console settings
